text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. In this year-end 
showdown, the one standing before 
Manhattan Cafe is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto. The 
strongest duo, repeatedly finishing 
one-two in Senior G1 races. Truly twin 
pillars standing side by side at the 
pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse was buzzing with excitement 
before the race, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Someone completely different from my 
"friend." I can't see... the shape of 
their soul...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it just doesn't click, you know? I 
don't get the feeling the acting will mesh 
well...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is far too mismatched to be my 
co-star. An operetta and a splatter film 
are entirely different things.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um, let's all get along, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't really feel like a fierce 
rivalry. It's more like... two different 
sports entirely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't suppress your adrenaline 
secretion! Let it gush out! Gush, I tell 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe gives a small nod to Agnes 
Tachyon's impassioned rally. Walking over 
to her side—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's just as Tachyon-san says... 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We will walk... our own path... And we 
will surely save our "friend"...
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can catch up now!
Yeah, we can catch up now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho was a race where she fell 
just one step short of her "friend." In 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Growing even further from that point, 
today, Manhattan Cafe will definitely 
catch up. To the goal she has pursued 
since childhood."
